description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - Do rescind the regulation Promulgated by Gazette Extraordinary No. 2362/30 dated 12.12.2023
reasoning: This gazette content involves the rescission of a regulation made under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973. It deals specifically with legal/regulatory matters - the modification (rescission) of existing regulations due to clerical errors. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory authority under existing legislation rather than announcing personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter.
